decision: Selected the planar centroid (computed in WGS 84 / UTM zone 10N) of the union of the three Crook County tax lots whose recorded owner is Apple Inc, as a campus locator for Apple's Prineville data-centre campus. The union is one contiguous polygon and the centroid lies inside it.

facts.query: OWNER_NAME = 'APPLE INC' returns exactly these three tax lots; the earlier OWNER_NAME LIKE 'APPLE INC%' attribute query (crook-taxlots-apple-attrs.json) returned the same three
facts.imagery_check: The county's 2020 orthoimagery export of the area (crook-imagery-2020-campus.jpg, sha256 267006db08991e9124eba8c40522a510583a24ce8d6f28fc4035d3c9e6ebe18f) shows a large two-hall data-centre-type building at about -120.873 to -120.867, 44.286 to 44.289, inside tax lot 1515000000312; a separate multi-building campus on lots of Vitesse LLC on SW Connect Way lies about 1.5 to 2 km to the north-west, outside the Apple lots.
facts.exhibit_check: Exhibit A of the 13 October 2026 development agreement (an aerial plan by Parametrix) labels APPLE CAMPUS east of the SW Connect Way buildings and north-east of Prineville Airport, beside the PRZ06 offsite utility lines along SW Baldwin Road, consistent with the Apple-owned lots.
facts.coordinate_reference_system: WGS84 longitude/latitude returned with outSR=4326 from the county service stored in NAD83(HARN) / Oregon GIC Lambert (EPSG:2914); centroid computed in EPSG:32610 and transformed back
facts.personal_data_note: Only lots owned by Apple Inc were requested with owner fields; nearby lots were read without owner fields except six industrial lots checked by tax-lot number, one of which belongs to a private trust whose name is not recorded anywhere in this packet.
facts.verification_script: parcel_geom.py (pyproj 3.7.1, PROJ 9.5.1, shapely 2.1.1; uv run --no-project, python -I)

excluded_locators.reason: An assessor situs label without a published address point; the selected lot polygon contains it.

excluded_locators.kind: Prineville city centre or Prineville Airport
